name: dsh-action-parity
description: Evidence that CLI, MCP and GUI bindings reach the same action core

interface.shortDescription: Verify one action core across every interface.
interface.longDescription: Checks stable Action IDs, content-addressed core and binding declarations, deterministic replay observations, optimistic state versions, conflict behavior and confirmation parity across CLI, MCP and GUI surfaces.
interface.defaultPrompt: Verify this action parity manifest and replay evidence without executing business actions.
